name: Market Feeds
description: Product export feeds for OpenCart 4.x: Rozetka XML, Prom.ua YML, Google Merchant Center and Meta catalogue (RSS with g: namespace) — variants from size/colour options grouped by item_group_id, real dispatch time (min/max handling time), token-protected storefront feed URLs, streaming XMLWriter output, category/manufacturer filtering, special price, availability + stock mapping, attributes as <param>, optional feed file cache via cron.
author: CatCode
